PluginData.Author: Local development
PluginData.Tooltip: Streams atomic.fm from Icecast into the Space Engineers client.
PluginData.Description:
atomic.fm is a prototype client-side plugin for Space Engineers plugin loaders such as Pulsar.
It plays a configured HTTP/HTTPS stream through the local Windows audio device. Any terminal block with atomic.fm=true in Custom Data can act as a client-side radio anchor. The default stream URL targets the SAM Broadcaster to Icecast mount at /atomic-radio.
